Noted, Ilse. I replied in your #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November, and I saved that to the knowledge brain against the account. No action is needed from you.

The brain's notices say that near-duplicate facts are not detected yet, so if someone adds the same renewal date with different wording, it may be stored twice. The brain owner can also widen this connection's tool access; I haven't changed that.
